title: fix(metrics): retain detection tensor columns for empty pages
body: ## Summary The JSON detection loader converts an empty page to a tensor with shape `(0,)`. Matching expects a prediction matrix with six columns and a target matrix with five columns, so blank pages or pages without annotations raise an `IndexError` during document evaluation. Reshape each loaded page to its declared matrix format. Nonempty page values and layout are unchanged; empty predictions and empty targets can now participate in the existing matching and metric calculations. ## Validation - Added 10 native JSON-to-metrics tests: 7 fail and 3 pass on the unchanged base; all 10 pass after the fix. - Covers all empty/nonempty prediction and target combinations, blank pages at different document positions, false-positive and false-negative pages with hand-calculated precision/recall/F1/AP, and the existing empty-document sentinel. - Preserves the existing undefined (`NaN`) metrics when no class has any ground-truth targets. - Ruff 0.15.10 check/format and `git diff --check` pass. The full optional-dependency suite was not run. ## Checklist - [x] Added regression tests for the behavior change. - [x] Preserved nonempty tensor layout and metric conventions. - [ ] Apply the `bug` label.
